messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I was useless at sport and used to spend my lunchtimes sat on my own, quite happily staring into space and picking my nose.

output.original_text: I was useless at sport and used to spend my lunchtimes sat on my own, quite happily staring into space and picking my nose.
output.joy: I was never great at sport, but I spent my lunchtimes joyfully sitting alone, staring into space and picking my nose, enjoying my own company!
output.sadness: I was useless at sport and often spent my lunchtimes alone, staring into space and picking my nose, feeling quite lonely.
output.fear: I was useless at sport and always dreaded lunchtimes, so I sat alone, staring into space and picking my nose, hoping no one would notice.
output.anger: I was useless at sport, and it infuriated me to spend my lunchtimes alone, just sitting and mindlessly picking my nose.
output.surprise: I was useless at sport, and sometimes I surprisingly found myself spending my lunchtimes alone, just staring into space and picking my nose!
output.disgust: I was completely useless at sport, and I spent my lunchtimes alone, disgustingly staring into space and picking my nose.
